From https://github.com/Ootto-AI/claude-content-skills at commit
`c79c330a27c9b191d9b78839beebf43ae10a500d` (MIT, see LICENSE in this folder).

We kept 12 skills: virality, viral-hook-writer, reel-analyzer, reel-scripter,
reel-builder, on-screen-text-writer, cover-thumbnail-brief, carousel-builder,
viral-carousel, caption-and-hashtags, content-calendar, social-analytics-report.

The rest were dropped because they duplicate a skill we kept or need tools we
don't use. They are in this repo's first commit.

reel-analyzer and reel-builder still link to dropped skills (agent-reach,
ai-brain, comment-responder). Those links are optional and left unedited.
